changes: Choose which Google account Omi reads email from — in Settings and during onboarding — instead of silently connecting the first readable browser profile
Gmail account selection now fails closed when browser identity cannot be verified, keeps reads on the selected profile, and cancels onboarding selection safely
Improved Claude Code and Codex connections so they automatically know how to use your Omi context
Your AI profile is now generated by Omi’s managed model instead of a separate desktop model
Calendar, Gmail and Apple Notes imports now use Omi’s managed synthesis instead of a separate desktop model
Memory-log import and knowledge-graph discovery now use Omi’s managed extraction instead of a separate desktop model
The Home tab is now called Chat, with a chat icon
Fixed an invisible area around the floating notch that could block buttons in Omi and other apps
Home now opens straight into your chat with Omi; the activity timeline moved to a new Activity tab in the renamed Memories section, and the window hides when you click away
Beta updates now ship automatically every hour whenever new fixes have merged
Reliability fix in the chat knowledge-graph tooling
Fixed invisible dead zones: the notch overlay no longer swallows clicks meant for windows beneath it (including Omi's own top navigation)
Notch notifications are wider and more legible — a larger accent icon, bigger title and body text, and roomier spacing so proactive nudges are easy to see at a glance
Fixed routine button actions playing unnecessary click sounds
The Command-O window now closes when you click the desktop or another app

Focus nudges now name your due-today tasks when you're drifting, AI-captured tasks wait in a collapsed Suggestions section until you accept them, and two capture bugs that silently disabled all proactive notifications (phantom Mission Control, phantom idle) are fixed
Improved chat tool progress with an animated timeline that extends as each step starts
Fixed an issue that delayed app updates from being delivered
